newsitem.title: USA: Bass group has stake in Onyx Acceptance.
newsitem.headline: Bass group has stake in Onyx Acceptance.

text.p: A group that includes members of the Bass family of Forth Worth, Texas, said Monday it has acquired 348,000 common shares of ONYX Acceptance Corp, or 6.0 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which includes Sid R. and Lee M. Bass, said it acquired the state for investment purposes.
The group said it bought a net 218,000 of the shares between November 14 and January 10 at prices ranging from $8.38 to $9.67 a share.
